title: Landmaark Developer
overview: Landmaark Developer required a centralized digital platform to streamline property sales operations, broker management, project marketing, and customer visit scheduling. As their property portfolio expanded across multiple prime locations, the traditional methods of managing sales and coordinating with a growing network of independent brokers became increasingly unsustainable.

We built a comprehensive, cloud-native web ecosystem consisting of an Admin Management Portal and a Broker Management Portal, effectively unifying the entire sales funnel. The platform empowers brokers to seamlessly access real-time property information, schedule client visits, track their commissions, and grow their referral networks from a single, unified and highly responsive dashboard.
problemIntro: Before digitalization, the client faced several operational bottlenecks that slowed down sales and reduced visibility:

problems.title: Manual Property Tracking
problems.desc: Property inventory, unit availability, and pricing were managed on scattered spreadsheets, leading to frequent double-bookings and outdated information.

problems.title: Lost Leads & Inefficient Visits
problems.desc: Follow-ups and site visits were inefficiently tracked over phone calls and WhatsApp, resulting in high lead drop-off rates and poor customer experience.

problems.title: Broker Coordination Chaos
problems.desc: Managing a multi-level network of referral brokers became a logistical nightmare, with delayed commission payouts and lack of transparent communication.

problems.title: No Management Visibility
problems.desc: Leadership lacked a centralized view of sales performance, making it difficult to forecast revenue, track team KPIs, or optimize marketing strategies.

solution: Our team developed a complete real estate sales management platform with dedicated, secure portals for both administrators and brokers. By digitizing the entire property sales workflow, we eliminated the dependency on manual data entry and created a single source of truth for all stakeholders involved in the sales process.

Administrators can now manage projects, update inventory, and approve payouts from a centralized dashboard. Simultaneously, brokers are empowered to instantly book client site visits, access high-quality marketing materials, and track their earnings in real-time, resulting in a highly motivated and efficient sales force.

modules.title: Smart Broker Dashboard
modules.desc: Centralized interface for brokers to manage leads, visits, and clients.

modules.title: Live Property Inventory
modules.desc: Real-time tracking of unit availability and pricing to avoid double-bookings.

modules.title: Multi-Level Referral Network
modules.desc: Manage and track broker hierarchies and multi-tier referral structures.

modules.title: Automated Visit Booking
modules.desc: Streamlined scheduling for customer site visits and follow-ups.

modules.title: Commission Tracker
modules.desc: Transparent real-time tracking of broker payouts and earnings.

modules.title: Marketing Asset Hub
modules.desc: Central repository for brochures, floor plans, and promotional materials.

conclusion: The transition to a fully digital real estate ecosystem completely eliminated the logistical nightmare of managing scattered spreadsheets and phone calls.
By empowering brokers with a smart portal and providing admins with total oversight, Landmaark Developer significantly accelerated their sales cycles.
summaryText:
• Centralized Admin and Broker management system.
• Digital property and project management.
• Easy visit booking and referral tracking.
• Real-time commission and earnings monitoring.
• Faster sales operations and workflow management.
• Improved transparency across the platform.
• Complete digital real estate ecosystem.
